summary: The top of one record's single view: what it is, its state, its key fields and what can be done with it.
not_for: A section heading inside the record (a heading on the page ground).

slots.when: A media-led record, such as a product: the main image beside the title block.
The record is a product buyers rate: the average and the number of ratings.
The record is a product on sale: the price, the largest text of the buy area.
A product on sale: a line each under the price for shipping, points, the delivery date and the seller, tagged [offer].

rules.rule: The title is the record's own name, as the collection shows it.
The back link's text is the title of the page it returns to.
The status sits beside the title.
Key fields: the few the reader decides by, four to seven at most.

One primary action, a verb and a noun, beside the title on a record of a work tool and under the price on a product page. Actions unique to this record come first; generic ones (duplicate, archive, delete) last.
On a product page the price is the largest text of the buy area, the rating and its count sit by the title, and the count links to the reviews.

evidence.says: A page carries a title, title metadata such as a status badge, a back action labelled with the parent page title, one primary action, then secondary actions.
The page header holds the title, a trailing visual for status, and the actions; a large variant serves user-generated titles.
The first field of a compact layout shows at the top in bold; the highlights panel shows up to seven fields.
Data highlights show four properties of the record.
A full-page app opens with the object's name and its key details.

evidence.source: Product pages of Amazon.co.jp, 楽天市場, Yahoo!ショッピング, メルカリ, アスクル and 価格.com, captured 2026-11 (research/20261113-production-ui-ooui/corpus/anatomy_shop_product.json)
evidence.says: The price is 28px and the largest text of the buy area on 6 of 6 pages; the rating sits beside the title on 3 of 6 and the review count is a link on 4 of 6; a specification table shows on 6 of 6.
